newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon Co wins $153 million in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon Co wins $153 million in contracts.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers & Constructors said it had won two contracts together worth $153 million to build a manufacturing facility and replace steam generators.

The company said the first one was a $97 million turnkey contract from American Agri-Technology Corp for a grassroots manufacturing facility in Great Falls, Mont. The facility, whose construction is to be completed in two years, will produce ethanol, vital wheat gluten, wheat and barley meal, and carbon dioxide using wheat and barley as raw material, it said.

The company said second was a $56 million contract from Framatome Technologies to replace the steam generators at Public Service Electric and Gas Company's Salem nuclear power plant Unit 1 in Salem, N.J.
Raytheon Engineers & Constructors is an engineering, construction, and operations and maintenance company.
